programme.title: Fantastiskās būtnes: Grindelvalda noziegumi
programme.desc: Tumšais burvis Gelerts Grindelvads ir izbēdzis no apcietinājuma un sāk pulcēt sekotājus, no kuriem daudzi pat nenojauš viņa patieso mērķi: panākt tīrasiņu burvju kundzību pār visām nemaģiskajām būtnēm. Lai izjauktu Grindelvalda plānu, Albus Dumidors lūdz palīdzību savam bijušajam audzēknim Tritonam Skamanderam, kas piekrīt palīdzēt, neapzinoties draudošās briesmas.

programme.title: Adamsu ģimene 2
programme.desc: Jokainā, spokainā Adamsu ģimenīte dodas ceļā kopīgā braucienā pa dzimto zemi un iepinas neprātīgos piedzīvojumos. Šis ceļojums ir īstens Adamsu ģimenes saišu stiprības pārbaudījums, kas sagādās ne vienu vien nervus kutinošu situāciju. Savā celā viņi saskriesies ar visdažādākajiem varoņiem, pārbaudīs ģimenes vienotību, eksperimentēs, šo to uzlaidīs gaisā un to visu darīs savā unikālajā – Adamsu stilā!

programme.title: Mis Peregrīnas nams brīnumbērniem
programme.desc: Džeikam Portmenam (Eisa Baterfīlds) jau no mazotnes viņa vectēvs Eibs stāsta stāstus par to, kā viņš jaunībā cīnījies ar monstriem un dzīvojis Velsā Mis Peregrīnas namā brīnumbērniem. Džeiks saņem satrauktu zvanu no vectēva, tādēļ dodas uz viņa māju un atrod vectēvu bez acu āboliem. Pirms miršanas vectēvs liek viņam atrast 1943. gada 3. septembra cilpu. Terapeita mudināts Džeiks un viņa tēvs Frenks dodas uz Velsu meklēt noslēpumaino māju, taču uzzina, ka tā ir iznīcināta gaisa uzlidojumos. Džeiks caur portālu nokļūst citā pasaulē un iepazīstas ar mis Peregrīnu, kura pastāsta, ka viņi eksistē slēgtā laika cilpā, kas ir diena pirms nams tika iznīcināts. Viņa paskaidro, ka namā dzīvo brīnumbērni ar neparastām spējām. Mis Peregrīna, kad to vēlas, var pārvērsties par putnu. Vēl ir tādi bērni, kuri var manipulēt gaisu, kontrolēt uguni un atdzīvināt mirušos. Viņi dzīvo noslēgtībā, slēpjoties no mutētajiem brīnumbērniem, kuri var atjaunot savu cilvēcību, tikai apēdot brīnumbērnu acis. Tos vada Berons, kurš maina veidolu un kurš radījis mutētos brīnumbērnus, meklējot nemirstību. Džeiks atklāj beigtus ķermeņus, kuriem trūkst acu, un saprot, ka mājā ir iemitinājušies mutētie bērni. Mis Peregrīna nolemj, ka viņiem nams ir jāpamet. Džeiks atgriežas savā pasaulē un satiek ornitologu, kurš veic pētījumus grāmatai par putniem. Atklājas, ka viņš ir Berons un ka arī Džeika terapeits ir bijis Berons, kas piemānījis Džeiku, lai tas palīdzētu atrast Mis Peregrīnas namu. Berons sagūsta Peregrīnu putna veidolā, bet bērni ir ieslodzīti cilpā kopā ar nežēlīgo mutantu, kurš cenšas tos iznīcināt. Bērniem izdodas izbēgt, taču cilpa bez Mis Peregrīnas sabrūk. Bērni dodas glābt mis Peregrīnu, un sākas cīņa starp brīnumbērniem un Berona pakalpiņiem. Berons cenšas piemānīt bērnus, taču viņš galu galā iet bojā. Bērni dodas atpakaļ uz 1943. gadu, lai mis Peregrīna varētu atkopties no ievainojumiem. Džeiks atgriežas 2016. gadā un atklāj, ka vectēvs ir dzīvs.

programme.title: Ātrs un bez žēlastības 2
programme.desc: Pēc pilnīgas izgāšanās slepenajā misijā, kad policists Braiens O`Konors atlaiž brīvībā bandas vadoni Dominiku Toreto, viņam tiek dota pēdējā iespēja. Maiami drošības iestādes jau krietnu laiku meklē pierādījumus biznesmeņa Kārtera Verones netīrajam biznesam importa un eksporta darījumu piesegā. Pierādījumu nav, izņemot Verones saistību ar nelegālajām ielu autosacīkstēm. Iefiltrējoties ielu autosacīkšu cienītāju grupā, O’Konora uzdevums ir atklāt Verones saikni ar naudas atmazgāšanu, darot to, ko viņš prot vislabāk – plātīties un spiest pedāli grīdā. Taču karstgalvim ir savi noteikumi. Izbrāķējis visus potenciālos slepenās misijas partnerus, O’Konors uzstāj par partneri pieņemt viņa bērnības draugu Romenu, kura kriminālā pagātne un mežonīgais autobraukšanas stils ir kā radīti slepenajam uzdevumam.

programme.title: tilts
programme.desc: Kad Andrē Deiviss bija vēl mazs zēns, viņa tēvu – Ņujorkas policistu – apšaudē nogalināja. Vienam no vainīgajiem toreiz izdevās izbēgt. Nu Deiviss pats kļuvis par likuma aizstāvi un katrā neģēlī, kurš nogalina policistu, saskata tēva slepkavu. Kad kāda aplenkuma laikā iet bojā vairāki policisti, Deiviss dodas palīgā tvarstīt šos kārtībsargu slepkavas. Pakaļdzīšanās uzņem arvien dramatiskāku virzību – tiek pieņemts lēmums veikt ārkārtējus pasākumus un slēgt visus Manhetenas tiltus, lai aizdomās turamajiem neizdotos izbēgt.

programme.title: Nekā deklarējama: Austrālija 15
programme.desc: Nedeklarētas lietas, aizliegtas vielas, mēģinājumi nelegāli iebraukt valstī, svešu cilvēku pases, aizdomīgi sūtījumi – tā ir robežkontroles darbinieku ikdiena. Viņu uzdevums ir identificēt un novērst noziedzīgas darbības – konfiscēt narkotikas, ieročus un citas aizliegtas lietas, neielaist valstī noziedzniekus un cilvēkus, kuri varētu mēģināt nelegāli uzturēties Austrālijā.

programme.title: Doktors Hauss 8
programme.desc: Seriāla pēdējā sezona ir klāt! Medicīnas spožākais prāts atgriežas, turpinot atklāt nopietnu slimību cēloņus un darot visu, arī pārkāpjot robežas, lai glābtu pacientu dzīvības. Ir pagājis gads, kopš Hauss ietriecās Kadijas mājā. Tagad viņš atrodas aiz restēm, bet jau pavisam drīz pārlieku tiešais un atklātais ārsts būs uz brīvām kājām. Atgriežoties ierastajā ārsta ikdienā, viņš atklās, ka daudz kas pa šo laiku tomēr ir mainījies. Tomēr pats Hauss nav kļuvis citāds - viņš turpina iet savu skarbā vīra ceļu un vājš kļūst tikai dažu sieviešu priekšā... Kad Hausa iemīļotā ielasmeita Emīlija nolemj precēties, viņš ir apņēmības pilns izjaukt sievietes vēl plaukumā esošās attiecības.

programme.title: Dzīve Tarongas zoodārzā
programme.desc: Raidījuma 7. sezona aicina skatītājus aizkulisēs, kur Sidnejas ikoniskajā zooloģiskajā dārzā ik dienu risinās neparasti dzīvnieku glābšanas un aprūpes stāsti. No paaugstināta riska dzīvnieku transportēšanas un uzvedības aktivizēšanas līdz aizkustinošai izglābto iemītnieku laišanai brīvībā – šis ir iedvesmojošs stāsts par Tarongas darbinieku pašaizliedzību un cīņu par sugu saglabāšanu.

programme.title: Gandrīz ideālas vakariņas
programme.desc: Garšīgais ciemošanās šovs “Gandrīz ideālas vakariņas” atkal priecē skatītājus! Četri dalībnieki nedēļas garumā cits pie cita viesosies, gatavos vakariņas un centīsies pārsteigt ar gardiem ēdieniem, radošām idejām un īpašu vakara noskaņu. Taču ne vienmēr viss noritēs pēc plāna – amizanti starpgadījumi un negaidīti pārsteigumi būs daļa no vakariņu šarma. Šova jaunajā sezonā savas mājokļu durvis vērs sabiedrībā zināmas personības, bet katra vakara noslēgumā viesi vērtēs gan ēdienus, gan radīto gaisotni. Pēc četriem vakariem augstāko punktu skaitu ieguvušais dalībnieks kļūs par nedēļas uzvarētāju un saņems vērtīgu balvu. Skatītājus sagaida sirsnīgas tikšanās, humors, pārsteigumi un iespēja ielūkoties iemīļotu personību ikdienā – šoreiz nevis uz skatuves vai ekrānā, bet pie vakariņu galda.

programme.title: Dr. Sirmais S04
programme.desc: Jaunajā sezonā Dr. Sirmais tiksies ar viesiem, kas vienreiz jau bijuši vizītē pie daktera, satiekoties vēlreiz ar kādu slavenību no iepriekšējām sezonām uz “otro vizīti”. Tikšanās laikā abi draudzīgi pārrunās iemācīto, vērtēs iepriekšējo padomu noderīgumu un pārbaudīs, vai viesu kulinārijas prasmes ir uzlabojušās. Otrajā vizītē Mārtiņš sagaidīs savus pacientus ar brīvdienu ēdienkarti, dodot praktiskus padomus un dažādus knifus brokastu, pusdienu un vakariņu ēdienkartēm, kas noderēs ne vien slavenībām, bet arī skatītājiem. Sirmais turpinās iedvesmot ar jauniem padomiem produktu izvēlē un gardu maltīšu gatavošanā, stāstot, kā to darīt lētāk un gudrāk!

programme.title: Caur ērkšķiem uz... 8.sezona
programme.desc: “Caur ērkšķiem uz…” dalībnieču ceļš ved uz Somiju – dažām tas ir pirmais ārzemju brauciens mūžā, un Skaidrītei jau Tallinā kāpšana uz Tallink prāmja prasa drosmi. Taču jaunus iespaidus pavada vecie ieradumi: par lamāšanos tagad jāpilda pietupieni, bet Helsinkos foto uzdevums liek atklāt, kādu iespaidu dāmas atstājušas cita uz citu. Vai visas būs gatavas dzirdēt arī nepatīkamo? Inetas dzimšanas dienas pārsteigumu un somu saunu papildina Mārtiņa sarūpēts cienasts, kura nogaršošanai vajadzēs saņemties – bēdīgi slavenā pūdētā siļķe. Savukārt Pūķu templī Somijas mežos nodarbība par uzticēšanos un spēju pateikt “stop” aizskar daudz personiskākas robežas – starp Ingūnu un Gintu rodas saspringts brīdis, kuru ar jokiem vien atrisināt nevarēs. Epizodes noslēgumā – balsošana uz prāmja klāja, kas aktualizēs sāpīgu tēmu: vai svarīgākas izrādīsies ceļabiedru pārmaiņas vai tikko piedzīvotais aizvainojums?

programme.title: Amerikas smieklīgākie video: Dzīvnieki
programme.desc: Pasaulē ik dienu notiek komiski, jocīgi, neizprotami un smieklīgi atgadījumi, tomēr tikai retajiem paveicas šos kadrus notvert videoformātā. Laiks pasmieties par neveiklībām, jokiem, izjokošanām, kļūmīgām situācijām, kuras iesūtījuši Amerikas iedzīvotāji, un šoreiz joku epicentrā ir neviens cits kā dzīvnieki. Katrā raidījumā tiek atlasīti trīs labākie video, un uzvarētājs, kuru nosaka skatītāji, iegūst vērtīgu naudas balvu.

programme.title: Džeimss Bonds. Rītdiena nemirst
programme.desc: Ietekmīgais mediju magnāts Eliots Krāvers cenšas izraisīt Trešo pasaules karu, sanaidojot Lielbritāniju un Ķīnu. Džeimsa Bonda jaunā misija ir iefiltrēties Krāvera starptautiskajā organizācijā. Krāvera sieva ir bijusī Bonda mīļāka, kas liek domāt, ka uzdevums būs šķietami viegls, bet, kad plāni noskaidroti, tad atklājas, ka Krāvers jau sen ir soli priekšā. Galvenās lomas filmā attēlo Pīrss Brosnans, Džonatans Praiss, Terija Hatčere

programme.title: Komisārs Reksis Vīnē
programme.desc: Pasaulē slavenākais četrkājainais detektīvs Reksis atgriežas pie savām saknēm – skaistajā Vīnē, kur kopā ar partneri, detektīvu Maksu Šteineru, risinās pat vissarežģītākās krimināllietas. Ar savu aso ožu, izcilo intuīciju un apbrīnojamo atjautību Reksis spēj uziet pēdas noziedzniekiem, pirms citiem izdodas atrast kaut mazāko pavedienu. Bet brīžos, kad situācija kļūst bīstama, viņš vienmēr ir gatavs steigties palīgā savam partnerim. “Komisārs Reksis” ir viens no starptautiski veiksmīgākajiem televīzijas seriāliem, kas ir iekarojis skatītāju sirdis visā pasaulē. Tagad leģendārais detektīvs atgriežas Vīnē, lai jaunā versijā turpinātu aizraujošos piedzīvojumus un pierādītu, ka noziedzības apkarošanā uzticams četrkājainais partneris ir neaizstājams.

programme.title: TIEŠRAIDE! Līmenis. Izbalsošana
programme.desc: Tiešraide! Sociālās realitātes spēles Līmenis iknedēļas izbalsošana.

programme.title: Izklausies redzēts
programme.desc: Latvijā ir atgriezies aizraujošs pārvērtību un talantu šovs Izklausies redzēts“, kurā septiņas Latvijā iemīļotas personības katru nedēļu pārtop par leģendāriem Latvijas un pasaules mūziķiem, atdarinot viņu balsi, tēlu, kustības un skatuves manieri. Šajā sezonā šovā piedalīsies mūziķi Andris Ērglis, Ralfs Eilands, Ieva Sutugova, Krisy, Elīna Fūrmane un aktieri Lelde Dreimane un Maksims Busels. Katram priekšnesumam dalībnieki gatavojas kopā ar profesionālu grima, stila, aktiermeistarības un horeogrāfijas komandu, bet viņu sniegumu vērtēs žūrija. Katras nedēļas izskaņā dalībnieki uzzinās, kuru mūziķi viņiem būs jāiemieso nākamajā reizē, tādējādi ikviens jauns priekšnesums kļūs par pārsteigumu gan pašiem dalībniekiem, gan skatītājiem. Sezonas noslēgumā trīs labākie dalībnieki cīnīsies par uzvaru, bet galveno balvu uzvarētājs ziedos paša izvēlētam labdarības mērķim.

programme.title: Non-Stop: tiešais reiss
programme.desc: Spriedzes filma ar Laiemu Nīsonu un Džulianu Mūru. Transatlantiskā avioreisa Ņujorka - Londona laikā ASV aviācijas policijas priekšnieks Bils Marks saņem vairākas īsziņas ar prasību pārskaitīt 150 miljonus dolāru uz kādu ārzonu kontu. Pretējā gadījumā tiek draudēts ik pēc 20 minūtēm nogalināt kādu pasažieri. Kad atklājas, ka konts ir atvērts uz paša Marka vārda, viņš tiek turēts aizdomās par lidmašīnas nolaupīšanu.

programme.title: Patēvs
programme.desc: Kad pusaudzis Maikls atgriežas mājās no militārās skolas, viņš atrod savu māti Sūzenu laimīgi iemīlējušos kādā Deividā Herisā. Deivids šķiet pilnīgi ideāls topošais patēvs — viņš ir gādīgs, šarmants un gatavs darīt visu ģimenes labā. Tomēr labāk iepazīstot mātes jauno vīrieti, Maiklu sāk mākt nopietnas aizdomas. Aiz nevainojamā vīrieša fasādes atklājas manipulācijas un bīstami noslēpumi, un drīz vien visas ģimenes locekļu dzīvības karājas mata galā. Spriedzes pilns psiholoģiskais trilleris par to, cik maz mēs patiesībā zinām par cilvēkiem, kurus ielaižam savās mājās.

programme.title: Holivudas policisti
programme.desc: Saņemot izsaukumu, detektīvi Gevilens un Kaldens apņēmības pilni uzsāk izmeklēšanu, taču ir kas tāds, kas viņiem regulāri traucē izmeklēšanas procesā ? viņu papildu nodarbošanās. Pieredzējušais policists Gevilens nodarbojas ar nekustamo īpašumu tirdzniecību, bet izskatīgais Kaldens cenšas apgūt aktiermākslu un pasniedz jogas nodarbības. Reizēm izrādās, ka brīdī, kad tiek novērta uzmanība, tas ļauj atklāt ļoti būtisku informāciju. Galvenajās lomās Harisons Fords un Džošs Hārtners.

programme.title: Detektīvs Kolumbo 5
programme.desc: Losandželosas slepkavību izmeklētājs leitnants Kolumbo varbūt ir necils pēc izskata un uzvedības – vienkārši ģērbies, kluss un pieklājīgs, skumji smēķē savu cigāru. Tomēr šī neievērojamā āriene slēpj, iespējams, neatlaidīgāko un drosmīgāko izmeklētāju pilsētā. Tieši Kolumbo tiek iedalītas skaļākās un sarežģītākās lietas, kurās iesaistīts Losandželosas pilsētas zieds – slavenie, bagātie un ietekmīgie. Ieraugot Kolumbo, vainīgie bieži jūtas uzjautrināti un drošībā – šis vīrs nebūs spējīgs viņus izskaitļot. Kolumbo pierādīs pretējo! Galvenajās lomās: Pīters Folks, Maiks Lalijs, Freds Dreipers

programme.title: Sūklis Bobs Kvadrātbiksis 13
programme.desc: Sūkļa Boba Kvadrātbikša un viņa zemūdens draugu piedzīvojumi turpinās! Atšķirībā no citiem Bobs Kvadrātbiksis ikdienas izaicinājumus nerisina loģiski, viņam patīk atrast neparastus veidus, kā tikt galā ar vienkāršām situācijām. Sūkļa labie nodomi, dedzīgā attieksme pret dzīvi un pārgalvīgās idejas rada haosu visā zemūdens pasaulē.

programme.title: Sūklis Bobs Kvadrātbiksis 13
programme.desc: Sūkļa Boba Kvadrātbikša un viņa zemūdens draugu piedzīvojumi turpinās! Atšķirībā no citiem Bobs Kvadrātbiksis ikdienas izaicinājumus nerisina loģiski, viņam patīk atrast neparastus veidus, kā tikt galā ar vienkāršām situācijām. Sūkļa labie nodomi, dedzīgā attieksme pret dzīvi un pārgalvīgās idejas rada haosu visā zemūdens pasaulē.

programme.title: Vilcienā cauri pasaulei 2
programme.desc: Aizraujošs ceļojumu raidījums, kas aicina izbraukāt pasaules iespaidīgākos un neaizmirstamākos vilcienu maršrutus. Raidījuma galvenais varonis ir vilciens — tas ved cauri elpu aizraujošām ainavām, vēsturiskām pilsētām un nomaļiem reģioniem, kur pārvietošanās pa sliedēm nav tikai, lai nokļūtu no viena punkta līdz otram – tas ir īsts piedzīvojums. Raidījums apvieno ainaviskus skatus, kultūras stāstus un dzelzceļa vēsturi, ļaujot atklāt gan pasaulslavenus, gan mazāk zināmus maršrutus, pa ceļam iepazīstot vietējās tradīcijas, cilvēkus paradumus, arhitektūru un inženiertehniskos risinājumus, kas padara katru braucienu unikālu.

programme.title: 15 jautājumi 2
programme.desc: Erudīcijas spēle katram darbdienu vakaram! Katru vakaru 15 jautājumi, viens uzvarētājs un 150 eiro balva. Spēli vada radio personība, dīdžejs un pasākumu vadītājs Magnuss Eriņš, bet par vakara erudītākā cilvēka titulu sacenšas divi dalībnieki. Noteikumi ir pavisam vienkārši – katram dalībniekam priekšā ir poga, kas kļūst aktīva, līdzko izskanējis jautājums. Kurš pirmais šo pogu nospiež, tas izvēlas jautājuma likteni – vai pats vēlas uz to atbildēt cerībā nopelnīt divus punktus, vai arī pirmo iespēju dot konkurentam, lai pats pēc tam mēģinātu tikt pie viena punkta. Kurš atbildējis pirmais un pareizi, tas tiek pie diviem punktiem, kurš otrais – pie viena, bet par nepareizu atbildi punkti nepienākas. Kuram vakara beigās vairāk punktu, tas arī uzvarētājs! Uzvarētājs saņem 150 eiro balvu un iespēju piedalīties nākamā vakara spēlē.

programme.title: Sadursme 360
programme.desc: Sadursme 360 ir 10 minūšu ikdienas operatīvo drošības dienestu ziņu raidījums ar galveno uzsvaru uz ceļu satiksmes drošību.

programme.title: Viens pret visiem
programme.desc: Erudīcijas un taktikas spēlē “Viens pret visiem” spēles dalībnieki stāsies duelī ar zināmām Latvijas personībām, katram liekot galdā savu trumpi – slavenībām talkā būs erudīti eksperti, bet pretiniekam – būs pirmais gājiens un iespēja taktiski izvēlēties tēmas, tostarp sev neērtākos jautājumus piespēlējot slavenībai. Katrā spēlē būs jauns spēlētājs, bet sabiedrībā zināmās personības komanda būs nemainīga visu nedēļu. Par spēles tempu, azartu un jautājumiem savukārt parūpēsies Gustavs Terzens. Kurš no dalībniekiem savu trumpi izspēlēs gudrāk? Vai uzvaru izšķirs zināšanas, taktika vai spēja riskēt īstajā brīdī?

programme.title: Gandrīz ideālas vakariņas
programme.desc: Garšīgais ciemošanās šovs “Gandrīz ideālas vakariņas” atkal priecē skatītājus! Četri dalībnieki nedēļas garumā cits pie cita viesosies, gatavos vakariņas un centīsies pārsteigt ar gardiem ēdieniem, radošām idejām un īpašu vakara noskaņu. Taču ne vienmēr viss noritēs pēc plāna – amizanti starpgadījumi un negaidīti pārsteigumi būs daļa no vakariņu šarma. Šova jaunajā sezonā savas mājokļu durvis vērs sabiedrībā zināmas personības, bet katra vakara noslēgumā viesi vērtēs gan ēdienus, gan radīto gaisotni. Pēc četriem vakariem augstāko punktu skaitu ieguvušais dalībnieks kļūs par nedēļas uzvarētāju un saņems vērtīgu balvu. Skatītājus sagaida sirsnīgas tikšanās, humors, pārsteigumi un iespēja ielūkoties iemīļotu personību ikdienā – šoreiz nevis uz skatuves vai ekrānā, bet pie vakariņu galda.

programme.title: SOKO Leipciga 21
programme.desc: Leipcigas policijas īpašā vienība SOKO – labākie no labākajiem, augstas klases profesionāļi, izmeklētāji, kas ķeras pie darba, lai atrisinātu smagākos un sarežģītākos pilsētā paveiktos noziegumus. Vienību vada ambiciozā vecākā policijas komisāre Ina Cimermane, kas kopā ar savu uzticamo komandu Janu Meibahu, Tomu Kovalski un Olīviju Faredi izmeklē smagus noziegumus – gan rūpīgi plānotas slepkavības, gan emociju karstumā paveiktas. Lai notvertu noziedzniekus, komanda piesaista valsts izcilākos ekspertus un labākos konsultantus. Galvenajās lomās: Melānija Marške, Marko Girnts, Štefans Šrūders, Nilama Faruka

programme.title: CSI Lasvegasa 5
programme.desc: Gregs kārto savu pēdējo kvalifikācijas pārbaudi, bet CSI izmeklētāju redzeslokā šoreiz kāds Šerloka Holmsa fans, kurš atrasts ar šautu brūci galvā. Voriks un Niks izmeklē mistisku autoavāriju, kur visi priekšnosacījumi vēsta, ka cietušais nemaz nav braucis ar mašīnu.

programme.title: Īstais CSI: Maiami
programme.desc: Dokumentālais seriāls, kas piedāvā ieskatītos reālu slepkavību izmeklēšanā. Brutālas, nežēlīgas un neizprotamas slepkavības, kas šokē Maiami iedzīvotājus – kas un kāpēc tās paveica? CSI Maiami detektīvi atklāj, kā puzles gabaliņi tika likti kopā, lai sadzītu pēdas vainīgajiem.

programme.title: Četri uz koferiem 4
programme.desc: Raiba kompānija – dziedātāja Samanta Tīna, mūziķis Lauris Reiniks, grupas “Prāta vētra” dalībnieks Jānis Jubalts un žurnāliste Ieva Adamss dodas eksotiskā ceļojumā uz tālo Dienvidamerikas pērli – Peru.

programme.title: NCIS: Losandželosa 4
programme.desc: Slavenā NCIS Losandželosas īpašā vienība ķeras pie darba! Augsti kvalificēti, pieredzējuši un spējīgi – viņi tiek piesaistīti lietās, kurās uz spēles ir valsts drošība. Komandu vada augumā necilā, tomēr ļoti spējīgā Hetija, kuras apskaužamās zināšanas, skarbā attieksme un ciešais skatiens iedveš bailes kā noziedzniekiem, tā viņas padotajiem. Īpašais aģents Džī Kalens iepriekš stradājis FIB, Narkotiku apkarošanas administrācijā un Centrālajā izlūkošanas pārvaldē, bet viņa pārinieks Sems Hanna ir ar militāru un sporta pieredzi un kopā ar savu uzticamo komandu viņi ir neapturami un spēj aizturēt pat visrūdītākos noziedzniekus. Galvenajās lomās: Kriss O’Donels, LL Cool J, Linda Hanta

programme.title: CSI Maiami 1
programme.desc: Kādā mājā nogalināta ģimene. Dzīva palikusi vien divgadīgā meitiņa, kura tiek atrasta asinīm noklātā rāpulītī klīstam pa ielām, bet tēvs ar šautu brūci nogādāts operāciju zālē. Sākotnējie pieņēmumi vedina domāt, ka slepkava ir mirusī māte, kura cīnījusies ar pēcdzemdību depresiju, līdz izmeklētāji nonāk uz pēdām citai versijai.

programme.title: Līmenis
programme.desc: Latvijā vēl nebijuša mēroga sociālās realitātes spēle, kas 35 dienas 24 stundas diennaktī ļaus skatītājiem reāllaikā sekot līdzi tam, kādi brīnumi notiek, kad tā dalībniekus, tādus pašus cilvēkus kā ikviens no mums, sadala divās krasi atšķirīgās pasaulēs. Vieni baudīs komfortu un privilēģijas, kamēr otri dzīvos daudz skarbākos apstākļos, strādās, pelnīs un cīnīsies par iespēju uzlabot dzīves apstākļus. Abas pasaules būs cieši saistītas, bet spēles gaitu nemitīgi mainīs skatītāju balsojumi, izbalsošanas, dalībnieku rotācija un iespēja pāriet no viena līmeņa uz otru. Līmenis - tā ir sociālā piramīda realitātes šova formātā, kurā tiek pārbaudītas ne tikai dalībnieku izdzīvošanas spējas, bet arī viņu attiecības, vērtības un priekšstati par taisnīgumu. Līmenis 24/7 skatāms tiešraidē Tet+, bet televīzijas skatītāji var sekot līdzi ikdienas 30 minūšu epizodēm un iknedēļas izbalsošanas tiešraidēm.

programme.title: Gandrīz ideālas vakariņas
programme.desc: Garšīgais ciemošanās šovs “Gandrīz ideālas vakariņas” atkal priecē skatītājus! programme.title: 360 Ziņas
programme.desc: 360 Ziņas ir dinamisks un mūsdienīgs TOP7 dienas svarīgāko Latvijas un pasaules notikumu apskats, kas palīdz saprast, kāpēc tas ir svarīgi tieši tev. TOP7 apvieno ātru tempu, saprotamu valodu, dažādus viedokļus un cilvēku pieredzes, kā arī skaidrojošu pieeju bez informācijas pārslodzes un liekvārdības, palīdzot orientēties informatīvajā troksnī un īsā laikā ar TOP7 iegūt skaidru priekšstatu par dienas būtiskāko.

programme.title: Viens pret visiem
programme.desc: Erudīcijas un taktikas spēlē “Viens pret visiem” spēles dalībnieki stāsies duelī ar zināmām Latvijas personībām, katram liekot galdā savu trumpi – slavenībām talkā būs erudīti eksperti, bet pretiniekam – būs pirmais gājiens un iespēja taktiski izvēlēties tēmas, tostarp sev neērtākos jautājumus piespēlējot slavenībai. programme.title: Slavenības. Bez filtra 15
programme.desc: “Slavenības. Bez filtra” atkal ver durvis slavenību dzīvei bez izskaistināšanas tur, kur emocijas, attiecību drāmas un skaļākie ikdienas mirkļi notiek pa īstam. Viņi uzdrīkstas iet savu ceļu un būt paši, īsti un drosmīgi! Ikviens varēs pievienoties Kaspara un Olgas Kambalu, latgalietes Margaritas Kolosovas, dzejnieces Magones Liedeskalnas un influenceru Sindijas Bokānes un Nika Endziņa ikdienai, kā arī raudzīt jaunas sejas, tostarp skaistuma dīvu Kristīni Lindenblati.

programme.title: Sliktie puiši
programme.desc: Maiami detektīviem Maikam Lourijam un Markusam Brenē ir tieši trīs diennaktis laika, lai atrastu heroīna kravu 100 miljonu dolāru vērtībā, citādi viņi tiek atlaisti no darba. Likmes paliek vēl augstākas, kad viņu tuvu draugu nogalina narkotiku dīleri. Bet lieta kļūt vēl sarežģītāka, kad detektīviem ir jāpārliecina slepkavības lieciniece, ka ar viņiem ir vērts sadarboties.

programme.title: Четверо на чемоданах 5
programme.desc: Šīs dienas programmu eksotiskajā Malaizijā sagatavojusi māksliniece Elita Patmalniece.Viņa iecerējusi braucienu uz salu, kur sastopami agresīvi pērtiķi. Tomēr lielākais izaicinājums izrādās tropiskās lietus gāzes! Vai visi no lietus meža izkļūs sveiki un veseli?

programme.title: Четверо на чемоданах 6
programme.desc: В эфир возвращается любимое зрителями трэвел-шоу «Четверо на чемоданах»! С новым сезоном, с новыми захватывающими приключениями! Знаменитости пакуют чемоданы, чтобы отправиться в незабываемые путешествия, которые в этом сезоне приведут их в далекие и экзотические страны. В первой поездке актриса Лелде Дреймане, голос Латвийского радио Томс Гревиньш, певица Иева Сутугова и шеф-повар Мартиньш Сирмайс познакомятся с культурой, кулинарными чудесами и великолепной природой необычного Вьетнама. Путешествие будет увлекательным, полным необычных событий, испытаний и сюрпризов. После этого пути знаменитостей приведут их в жемчужину Африки — Кению — и многие другие интересные страны. Путешествуйте по миру вместе со знаменитостями в 6-м сезоне шоу «Четверо на чемоданах»!

programme.desc: В эфир возвращается любимое зрителями трэвел-шоу «Четверо на чемоданах»! С новым сезоном, с новыми захватывающими приключениями! programme.title: Четверо на чемоданах 5
programme.desc: Pēdējā ceļojuma dienā par grupas izklaidēm atbildību uzņemas Diāna Kubasova. Viņa visus ved uz skaisto Dubrovniku, kura slavena ne vien ar neparasto vecpilsētu, bet arī faktu, ka tajā filmēts slavenais seriāls “Troņu spēles”. Diāna ir šī seriāla fane un tādēļ viņai divu stundu ekskursija pa pilsētu kopā ar gidu ir bauda. Pārējie seriālu nav redzējuši - kā viņiem patīk šī ekskursija? Vēl Diāna uzskata, ka “piķis nav problēma” un tādēļ par vairāk nekā 100 eiro četrotne dodas ar funikulieri kalnos… Vai visam pietiks naudas? Diānas diena noslēdzas ar izbraucienu pa jūru ar saulrieta vērošanu un vakariņām uz kuģa. Labi, ka pa tām samaksāts jau iepriekš…

programme.title: Сваты 5
programme.desc: С момента последних событий прошло 8 лет. Молодые Ковалевы возвращаются на родину из Голландии, где они жили все эти годы. Женечка повзрослела и стала готом – носит черную одежду, красится в черный цвет, конфликтует с родителями и шутит «по-черному». Младшие Никита и Вика - современные дети, не по годам смышленые и расчетливые. Бабушки и дедушки на все лето забирают к себе внуков, а значит, нас ждут новые задорные, веселые и интересные истории…

programme.title: Мир наизнанку. Вьетнам 4
programme.desc: Стартует четвертый сезон программы Мир наизнанку, посвященный Вьетнаму. На этот раз мы будем знакомиться с традициями племени мнонгов, отправимся в большую экспедицию и вместе с командой охотников попытаемся поймать в джунглях дикого слона. Будем изучать супертуристический вьетнамский курорт Нячанг и его окрестности, только, как всегда, с изнанки. Как рождается морская экзотика и кулинарная роскошь - учимся разводить омаров, лобстеров и устриц. Из чего делается самый вонючий соус в мире - раскрываем кулинарные секреты приготовления традиционного вьетнамского соуса ныок мам. Как развлекаются вьетнамцы - устроим настоящие поросячьи бега, гонки велорикш и заплывы на плетенных лодках-тазиках. продолжим исследовать город- курорт Нячанг.

programme.title: След
programme.desc: В Федеральной Экспертной Службе (ФЭС) собрано все, что может помочь расследованию самого запутанного преступления. В нее за помощью могут обратиться не только высокие чины прокуратуры, но и простой оперативник, экспериментальная лаборатория оборудована по последнему слову техники, и каждый из ее работников - уникальный специалист в своей области. Их задача помогать и направлять следствие, изучая улики, находить ту самую важную, благодаря которой удастся определить настоящего виновника. Каждый день они работают, чтобы ни одно преступление не осталось безнаказанным. В 39-минутных минифильмах сотрудники ФЭС расследуют сложные дела, выводя виновных на чистую воду.

programme.desc: Нескладный грабитель банка захватывает в заложники бывшего «крутого» заключенного. Полиция бросается за ними в погоню, герои меняются ролями. «Заложник» становится нянькой «похитителя» и «отцом» его немой дочери. Springing into action, the team drives off the raptors and rescues the frightened little dino! Unbeknown to the Ranchers, the raptors follow them back to the Dino HQ, and they must know protect the baby dino once again

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The volcano on Dino Island is ready to blow! The Ranchers' mission: rescue a cluster of dino eggs too close to the volcano's fiery base before the heat turns their nests into ash! The operation hits a snag when a frantic Plesiosaur needs help! Jon frees the panicked creature, and the two become fast friends! He names her Noodles, and she's eager to help, maybe a little too eager!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean finds himself lumbered with an unwanted pet in the form of a four-legged ball of pink fur with piggy eyes and a penchant for earthworms. Encyclopedias leave him none the wiser as to the identity of the pesky creature but Bean can’t bring himself to just abandon it. The puzzle is eventually solved after a picnic in the park and a raid on the local pet shop.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean forgets the golden rule: never fall asleep in the bath when you've got a chicken in the oven. So what romantic meal can he quickly rustle-up for his luckless girlfriend, Irma Gobb? The cheese from the mousetrap? The flower from the vase? A meal is eventually provided by an uninvited guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at a farmers’ market with Irma at her knitwear stall – right next to a man selling novelty teapots. Bean is instantly smitten with a green car-shaped one but can’t afford it. When he visits a food truck that’s laid out free samples, he hatches a plan to swipe them and sell them on his own stall so he can raise the cash for the teapot of his dreams!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is watching Clint Chiseljaw - his favourite action TV show - with Billy, but Mrs Wicket orders her nephew downstairs to finish his chores. Inspired by Clint’s catchphrase – “Nobody gets left behind”, Mr Bean tries a variety of different daring plans to break Billy out of Mrs Wicket’s flat. But none of them work, until he hits on the perfect plan… or so he thinks!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Shaggy takes the Gang to the Minor League Baseball stadium of his youth only to learn that it's about to be shut down because a Ghostly Baseball Player is scaring away the fans - and the team! Shaggy puts aside his cowardly ways to save his home team. But will Scooby stand by his (now not-so-scared) pal?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: When an Artificial Intelligence takes over the building of a trendy tech company, the gang has to solve the computerized mystery - and maybe learn a lesson about relying too much on technology.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: The Gang has seats on the largest airplane ever to fly the open airways! Unfortunately, the plane is also beset by a Gremlin bent on sabotaging the flight! The Gang has to step up to solve the airborne mystery as well as deal with something even scarier: Daphne in the pilot seat!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy finds two identical vases that are actually communicating vessels in a Native American Indian chest. If he sticks his hand in one, it comes out the other, between them. This should satisfy Grizzy's natural lazy streak, regardless of the distance unless the Lemmings realize the incredible games they could play with the magic vases.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a vintage stopwatch in the garage which lets you wind back the minute that has just passed by and it can even stop time and movement in one's surroundings. This will give him a sure advantage over the Lemmings, provided of course they don't get their hands on it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy is disturbed in the middle of his TV snack by a strange flow of incongruous objects that have been transformed into hot-air balloons. When he sees the Lemmings onboard these curious zeppelins, Grizzy understands that he will quickly have to confiscate their helium tank and balloons if he wants to relax in front of the TV.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers with great delight that the ranger has purchased a brand new multifunction Stressless recliner. But even an armchair designed for well-being - the ultimate in relaxation - can used for other purposes by the Lemmings, who transform it into a fearsome multi-game chair.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings play kite-surf with a homemade kite. Grizzy notices that the she-bear he's in love with watches the kite perform arabesques in the sky with admiration. He decides to make a kite that is far more sophisticated than the Lemmings kite.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy snatches the last jar of chocolate spread out from under the noses of the Lemmings. In exchange, he offers them the toy stuck inside the lid: a mini-flute. When the Lemmings blow into the flute, the shrill notes that come out paralyze anyone whose ears aren't plugged for several seconds. They decide to play a tune for Grizzy in order to recover their share of chocolate spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings play a new game, floating like flags in the breeze from the fan which is set at maximum. Grizzy, who has decided to watch his favorite TV documentary on salmon fish, quickly rids the living room of this interference. But he didn't anticipate that the Lemmings would continue their game on the roof with the wind pump and TV antenna, and that the interference would reappear... inside the TV!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a grand old time tearing down their Kapla block buildings, which they rebuild just as fast. Grizzy remarks that the she-bear he's in love with is impressed by the Lemmings' construction and makes believe that it's his work of art. But when the building collapses yet again, the she-bear walks off. Grizzy decides to build an even bigger one.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings draw inspiration from lessons they find in a martial arts book and start breaking every wooden object they can get their hands on into two. When Grizzy tries to stop them, they go on to the next lesson and get him in a judo hold. Grizzy understands that he needs the book so that he too can become a pro.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Jerry sneaks into the party set up to steal some cheese while Tom is sleeping. Tom wakes up and chases Jerry across a table filled with all kinds of food. During the chase, Tom eats a melon which turns him into a sphere shape and Jerry eats a piece of cheese which turns him into a triangle shape.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: When Tom goes through reverse evolution and is transformed into a swamp monster, he uses it to his advantage, scaring creatures that frightened him earlier. Soon he sees Van Mouseling in the woods and can't resist chasing him all over.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Kept awake by Tom watching TV, Jerry goes outside and encounters some lightning bugs. The smallest one can't keep up, so Jerry steals Tom's energy drink for the little guy. It helps, but soon the super-charged bug causes unexpected issues for Tom and Jerry.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Skullie warns Tom that it's almost midnight, so he'd best be on alert for one of the Catsylvania ghouls to show up. Tom reaches for a towel to wipe the soap out of his eyes but is shocked to discover that he's not using a towel at all, but a Mummy-cat's wrap! Soon, the Mummy-cat finds ways to freak out Tom and befuddle him, Jerry and Tuffy all over the house.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Hoping to woo Toodles, Tom decides to make some homemade perfume for her. He throws in many unusual ingredients and gets a surprisingly pleasant outcome, getting the attention he craved. However, soon Tom and Jerry must come up with a plan when the heavenly scent turns bad.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: When Tom and Butch both arrive to ask out Toodles, their competitive behavior prompts her to send them away to a charm school she recently attended. But how will they fare in the grueling etiquette courses taught by elegant cat instructors?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Things go awry when Cates orders Tom to clean and inspect the family automobile. Tom, Jerry and Tuffy end up taking the car into the countryside and doing their best to control it. As Tom reads and attempts to follow the instruction manual, Jerry and Tuffy help, but they also suffer many near-misses.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is far from thrilled to be going on a country walk with Irma to see an ancient ruin, especially when he sees a pair of ramblers with all the latest hiking kit. But instead of taking up their offer of help, he gets extremely competitive and is desperate to beat them to the stone circle, even when Irma gets fed up and joins her new hiking friends.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: In the run-up to a fundraising event for the Donkey Sanctuary, Irma realises she doesn’t have a posh dress, so Mr Bean goes to buy one for her. However, all the dresses are very expensive – but he comes up with a plan. He can buy a dress, then return it after the event provided it still has the label attached. Can Mr Bean protect the dress without Irma realising what he’s doing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Fed up of driving Mrs Wicket everywhere, Mr Bean decides to teach her how to drive. He sets up a practice “car” in his flat using tin cans as pedals and household objects for all the levers. Mrs Wicket does so well that Mr Bean lets her have a proper lesson in his beloved car – but Mrs Wicket gets carried away in the real car, and it’s a white-knuckle ride!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean wants to take a photo of a rare bird, the Rosy Starling, hoping to win a cash prize from a nature magazine. But the special nuts he’s bought to lure the bird have instead attracted a couple of persistent squirrels, who keep hopping onto the bird table he’s installed and helping themselves to the tasty nuts. It’s Bean vs squirrels, or so he thinks…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean buys himself a DIY remote-controlled boat kit so he can compete in a race on the local pond. But just as he’s about to finish it, Scrapper sniffs out some nearby sandwiches and causes havoc. In the confusion, Mr Bean thinks the cat has swallowed the rudder of his toy boat, so has to capture him and take him to the vet. Will he get his rudder back in time for the race?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: As Mr Bean settles down to watch his favourite TV programme he hears loud noises from next-door. He moves from house to garden but can’t escape the relentless cacophony of trumpets, electric drills, and screaming babies. Bean’s mind turns to thoughts of revenge….

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Jerry is raiding the fridge but gets caught by Tom. Tom tries to get the food back, but Jerry and Tuffy fight back by throwing food at Tom. Jerry accidentally throws Tuffy at Tom and has to rescue him.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Super-genius villain Egghead is on the loose, planning to use Gotham Museum’s famed giant egg to cook up a record-breaking breakfast.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: When Batman teams up with Aquaman to stop a sinister undersea plot, the Batwheels are excited to use their new cool underwater mode!

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: A music video introducing the villainous vehicle squad - The Legion of Zoom - introducing their shifty skills and pernicious personalities.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: The gang is honored to take part in the wedding of two close friends. But can Best Man, Shaggy, and Maid of Honor, Daphne, save their friend's perfect day before it's ruined by a tragic Ghost Bride bent on destroying everyone else's Happily Ever After?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: he gang head out to a Day of the Dead festival. There, they learn the spirit of the old, legendary criminal, El Bandito, has returned to terrorize the locals. Fred becomes obsessed with solving the mystery and becoming a part of the great legend, himself.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: While bickering with the Lemmings over control of the TV, Grizzy sees an illustration that gives him an idea. In a medical book, a person whose leg is in a cast is being served dinner in front of a TV. Grizzy pretends to have a twisted ankle and shows the Lemmings the patient care illustrations. The imaginary invalid Grizzy is so convincing that the Lemmings fall for the trick. They think that the sooner Grizzy is healed, the sooner they will be able to throw him out of the cabin as planned.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: On the beach, the Lemmings have set up a mini funfair for tourists. Each attraction lets you to win tickets, which are then used to collect prizes from a vending machine. Grizzy, who is not very good at games of skill, steals the tickets collected by the Lemmings in order to obtain the jackpot. The Lemmings decide to create an attraction just for him.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover that oysters can make pearls almost instantaneously: just put an object inside their shell and it’s automatically coated with mother-of-pearl The game of marbles that the Lemmings have invented with pearls is driving Grizzy crazy. He manages to catapult the Lemmings far away. But at the ocean bottom, they discover a giant oyster. All they need to create a giant-scale marble game!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings shiver with cold, sneeze and are glassy-eyed: they have a big fat cold! They look so pitiful that Grizzy doesn't have the heart to throw them into the void, even if they are extremely annoying when they try to snuggle up to him to keep warm. He decides to heal them: the quicker they get better, the quicker Grizzy will be able to get rid of them pitilessly.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a pack of icy mints that literally chill your breath. One blast from anyone who eats them freezes everything in sight. Grizzy does not particularly care for this frosty ambiance and tries to take their candy away.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy can't believe it: he has just swallowed a spoonful of his favorite food, chocolate spread, and he hates it! How could that be possible? And yet, when he swiped the jar from the Lemmings, they seemed to be enjoying it immensely. A quick investigation reveals that the Lemmings added a dash of lemon juice to the jar to give the spread a sharper taste. And they intend to jazz up the rest of the stock as well!

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput gets mistaken for a guide dog, and the Docs try to nab their quarry without disturbing an old lady's pleasant day in front of the wireless. Good thing she can't see the chaos going on.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers are buzzing with excitement -- Ma and Pa are finally visiting Dino Island! Jon, Min, and Miguel go all out preparing a grand welcome party, eager to show their parents just how far they’ve come as Dino Explorers! But Ma and Pa Cassidy find the island overwhelming, until their kids show them the wonder and fun of everything new.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Ma carefully chisels the perfect gemstone from a cave wall, a sparkling treasure she plans to craft into a beautiful bracelet for Pa, to celebrate their anniversary! There's just one problem: Bo forgot the anniversary! To make it right, Pa enlists the kids' help to find a gift worthy of Ma's sparkle! Their idea? The rare Lava Lily, a flower said to bloom only at the peak of the island's volcano!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is in the library studying his family heritage. Someone brings to his attention Mr Bean’s resemblance to a certain Lord Bean. Mr Bean sets off to track down his ancestral home (a castle) in Scotland where he is welcomed with open arms. But owning a castle is not cheap. Can Mr Bean escape before he runs out of money and has there been a case of mistaken identity?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean and his beloved car find themselves in a crash for crash battle with his arch nemesis the Reliant Robin. It’s a contest to find out who can hold their nerve the longest. Does Mr Bean win? Is his car left unscathed? And more importantly do we find out who the driver of the Reliant Robin really is?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean has got everything ready for Irma’s birthday; card cake candles but he just needs to get her some flowers. But nothing goes to plan as Mr Bean inadvertently causes a car crash involving a bride on her wedding day. There’s no time to lose as Mr Bean promises he’ll get the bride to the church on time. Irma is not a happy lady as Mr Bean is distracted by the task in hand.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Nipping to the shops for a few provisions becomes a nightmare when a mile-long shopping list from his landlady and a clapped out trolley with a wonky wheel conspire to ruin his day. Subscribing to the theory that bigger is better, he constructs his own shopping trolley incorporating a petrol mower, pram wheels and an extra pair of hydraulic hands.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Raccoon has set about clearing the forest of everything in sight: bark, pine cones, twigs.... But the Baby Lemmings are using all these elements to make increasingly incredible domino courses! When Baby Raccoon discovers this, he just feels they've made a mess of the forest again, and decides to pick it up despite the Baby Lemmings' annoyance.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: While eating breakfast, the Baby Lemmings discover a hot stone near a spring that enables them to cook their food. They find it incredible and decide to start cooking. Baby Owl, asleep nearby, is attracted by the smell and plunders their feast!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: It's a windy day in the Canadian forest, and Baby Lynx is having fun catching flying leaves like a little kitten. Meanwhile, the baby lemmings are discovering how to make kites out of leaves. When Baby Lynx sees them, she wants to catch them, and the baby lemmings have to be extra agile to dodge Baby Lynx's attacks.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs and Grim are trapped together in an observatory museum overnight.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs is overjoyed to find other rabbits living in the forest but getting their acceptance proves more difficult than he thought.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs discovers Bigfoot's fear of water and decides to teach him how to swim.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: After pillaging a monastery Yosemite Sam attempts to outwit an enlightened Bugs Bunny to receive the treasure of a lifetime.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang heads to the Velma's beloved authentic Renaissance Faire, where they must find a way to infiltrate the royal feast in order to stop an evil court jester from ending the king's reign, permanently, and closing the faire!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Finally fed up with monsters and mayhem, Shaggy and Scooby decide to quit the gang and train their replacements in one on-the-job training session, unraveling the mystery of a vampire that's terrorizing a small town.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean forgets the golden rule: never fall asleep in the bath when you've got a chicken in the oven. So what romantic meal can he quickly rustle-up for his luckless girlfriend, Irma Gobb? The cheese from the mousetrap? The flower from the vase? A meal is eventually provided by an uninvited guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean decides to do something romantic on Valentine’s Day for his long-suffering girlfriend Irma. But while he is secretly delivering her valentines card Mr Bean finds out he has a love rival for Irma’s attention. Bean steps up his efforts and takes Irma on a ‘date’ to the Valentine’s Fair only to find his love rival is there too! But will the fortune-teller’s prediction be the ticket to a happy ending?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: After Tyke digs up, Hammy, Spike's lucky bone, Spike reburies it right away because it's bad luck to remove it. Soon afterward, Tom gets a set of toy dog bones that do tricks, and he teases Spike and Tyke with them. When the whirly-bone buries itself and unearths Hammy for a second time, Spike recruits the other animals to help prevent the bad luck he expects.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: A ghost paints a flattering portrait of Tom, but Tom is stingy with his payment and the ghost casts a spell on the portrait. Strange things start happening as the portrait absorbs injuries and calories that should be affecting Tom. However, soon Jerry and Tuffy figure out what's going on and use it to their advantage.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: When Rick and Ginger are asked to dog-sit for a friend's French poodle, Sabrina, Tom is initially on his guard, but soon he's practically eating out of her hand. Next, Spike falls for Sabrina and does everything he can to impress her with how kind he is to Tom. How long will everyone's behavior be affected by Sabrina's presence?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a strange American Indian figurine with the power to switch the spirits of two living beings and finds himself imprisoned in the body of a caribou. He immediately tries to activate the reverse procedure, but the Lemmings steal the figurine in order to turn into a partridge and fly away.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: While salmon fishing on the riverbank, Grizzy hauls in an unusual catch: an old hand mirror straight out of a fairytale. Instead of showing the reflection of the person who holds it, the mirror shows an idealized vision of his surroundings. Whether it be Grizzy or the Lemmings, everyone sees the world of his dreams, and no one wants to share it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: In a casing that fell from a circus caravan, the Lemmings find a magic stick that can enchant objects and make them come alive. Grizzy is sure that a stick like that would save him a lot of work, the only problem is how to get it from the Lemmings, who have become sorcerer's apprentices?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Whilst trying to stop the Lemmings from playing with a crate of firework rockets, Grizzy is literally carried away with them when the largest specimen shoots off. When the entire crate of fireworks explodes with a boom, they are hurled out of the atmosphere and all the way to the moon.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: With their endless battles over the ranger's cabin which they do not want to share, Grizzy and the Lemmings end up blowing the cabin up. Amidst the debris, they discover a strange pack: an army tent with all the necessary equipment to recreate a home in nature. It's the chance to discover the joys of camping in the wild.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings encounter a white bear which has drifted all the way to them on a chunk of ice which is slowly melting. The bear makes a fabulous rodeo partner, he just needs enough ice to keep cool. Even a few ice cubes on his head are enough. The only obstacle to this beautiful friendship is Grizzy, who considers himself master of the fridge and thus of the cabin's ice production.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Kid Kazoom and Multy have to enter an active volcano to retrieve a new Kazoom fragment.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Everyone is ecstatic when Bibi, Batgirl, and Robin capture Toyman and his Do-Over remote – except for Bibi, who failed to stick the landing on a big jump. Unwilling to accept her failure, Bibi uses Toyman’s Do-Over remote until she perfects her jump!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When Bam is sent to take on Prank, Redbird is forced to hang back because The Joker’s van is too dangerous! When Bam discovers that Redbird secretly tagged along, he’s upset… until Redbird bails him out of a tight spot.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After Jestah’s insults get the best of her, a short-tempered Bibi tries to not let the big-wheeled bully's words get to her so she can help Batgirl catch Harley.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Feeling neglected after being passed over on missions, Bam asks MOE to install experimental upgrades to curry Batman's favor. But, when Bam's new powers are stronger than he can control, Batman – and the mission – are suddenly in danger!

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: Carina Capybara hires The Looney Builders to build her Samba School a float for Brazil’s Carnaval parade. She soon realizes the float will be even better if they incorporate her students’ ideas, and they all work together to revise the design.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired by Parth Peacock to build a puppet stage and puppets in India. They soon learn that Parth’s form of puppetry differs from their own and must correct everything in time for his big show.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: After a hot cocoa disaster, Santa Claus hires The Looney Builders to build him a new toyshop in time to save Christmas.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: Mayor Foghorn Leghorn hires The Looney Builders to build a giant water slide for Looneyburg’s waterpark. He keeps adding onto the design with the support of Bugs until problems arise.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: A music video of Daffy Duck using his dump truck to haul supplies and goof around on the job.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean takes a taxi to his local toyshop but a dodgy cabbie thinks he can take Mr Bean for a ride. After a mix up Mr Bean finds himself driving the taxi and starts to have fun couriering people to their destinations even giving an American tourist an extensive tour of London. But will the taxi driver find out what’s been going on and how much will Bean’s final fare be?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean needs to impress Irma who is infatuated with the hunky deliveryman. Bean tries to improve his physique at the gym but has little success. Instead he opts for an inflatable muscle suit. Irma is indeed impressed and Bean’s plan seems to be working – until the suit gets punctured and Bean makes the mistake of re-inflating it with helium. As Bean floats off into the sky will Irma’s admiration be punctured?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is settling in for his favourite TV show marathon when Irma rings to remind him they’re having lunch at her mum’s. He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him – but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all – no Teddy!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom And Jerry take their chase to the skies. Kite-flying has never been this intense. Who will emerge as the ultimate master of strings?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy gleefully discovers that he can print images taken with the ranger's camera which is connected to a state-of-the-art printer. He decides to immortalize and frame himself, but when the time comes to print his portrait, there's no more paper in the printer. The Lemmings have thrown themselves heart and soul into the regressive pleasure of paper airplanes.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: A van pulls up to the ranger's cabin to deliver a full crate of jars of chocolate spread. While Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a wrecking bar to open it, someone steals the crate. Grizzy and the Lemmings will have to carry out an investigation to find the trail of their treasure.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Like usual, Grizzy picks the door of the Ranger's log cabin to come in and make himself comfortable, but this time it's impossible to enter! The Lemmings have requisitioned the cabin for a party and barricaded themselves inside. Grizzy has no intention of waiting for an invitation to find a way to get in.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have got their hands on a pack of white beans which have very strange properties: when mixed with soda, anyone who eats them turns into a bouncing ball. Grizzy realizes that if he wants to take a nap, he must first get rid of the magic beans.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to get rid of the old piano in the garage at any cost, for the Lemmings love using it to make a dissonant racket. But when he happens to notice that the she-bear he's in love with likes the melody of Für Elise he decides to learn the learn the piece like a real pro.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings inherit a crate that fell off a Canadian army convoy transporting ultra-secret material. The case inside the crate emits a sort of laser beam that divides objects into multiple miniaturized versions of themselves. What if the Lemmings had to deal with lots of mini-Grizzys rather than just one big one?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Near the supermarket, a machine hands out surprise eggs in exchange for a coin. Amongst the lots to be won, there is a super firework rocket that makes the Lemmings dream, and a piece of costume jewelry that Grizzy imagines himself giving to his lady-love.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: At the Ranger's home, Grizzy finds a high-tech gadget that enables you to learn anything at all sewing, origami, Kung Fu, etc... within only seconds thank to electrodes hooked to the brain. He can now become the perfect bear! But first, he first needs a program to learn how to get rid of the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: An old metal box found by chance in a recess of a cliff brings back childhood memories for Grizzy and the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: How can one peacefully watch a documentary on salmon fish, nice and comfy on the sofa, when the Lemmings are playing chemistry novices with a fun experiment box? By confiscating their equipment? Beware of side effects.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy's TV remote control is stolen by a partridge who collects high-tech objects in his nest perched high up in a tree. This is a case of absolute urgency! Grizzy has no other choice but to requisition the Lemmings propulsion game to recover his possession. But try and make a Lemming understand that!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy has got it into his head to offer a butterfly to the she-bear he's in love with. But the Lemmings fight with him over the rare specimens he's spotted, for they want to play helicopter. The butterfly hunt is on!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have discovered an addictive new game based on the astonishing bouncing properties of the ranger's new running shoes. Grizzy, who is trying to relax, confiscates the shoes and soon realizes they are far more comfortable than his thongs.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy babysits for the she-bear he has a crush on, who has entrusted him with the care of her cub. There's no question of Grizzy tripping up, for he has no intention of taking any risks! But he hadn't reckoned on the Lemmings. Captivated by the baby's burps after meals, they dream of making it drink gallons of soda pop to make it do the Big One.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Unwilling to share the food both he and the Lemmings are wild about, Grizzy locks it up inside the ranger’s brand new and apparently burglar proof safe. He watches the Lemmings’ vain attempts to open the safe with amusement, until he realizes that the string around his neck with the key is far from indestructible.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean needs to clean up after working on his car. However each time he tries to get in the bath, he’s interrupted by plumbers who are doing work in Mrs Wicket’s bathroom. When they turn off the hot water and head off to lunch, leaving Mrs Wicket’s new bath on the front lawn, Mr Bean decides enough is enough. He fills the outdoor bath up and has a soak right there in view of everyone!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma calls Mr Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out. So he hatches a plan to intercept the singer, Signor Parmigiano, at the train station and trick him into playing in his back garden – a private performance for just him and Irma!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Jealous of Mr Paliwal’s new egg-laying chicken, Mr Bean heads off to the local farm to get himself one. But after causing havoc at the coop, he comes home with the wrong chicken – not only will it not lay eggs, but it turns out Mrs Wicket is allergic to feathers so Mr Bean has to keep the chicken well hidden!

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: The Docs prove their inventing skills by coming up with an age-altering time-ray. This breakthrough could change the world. If they used it for something other than chasing Lamput. Obsessed much, fellas? Wildly shooting their time-ray off in public causes a not-unsurprising amount of chaos, until the local law enforcement gets caught in the cross-fire. Looks like the Specs and Skinny are gonna be in jail till they get old the normal way.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When Manny’s missing page is replaced with the wrong kind of page, it leads to chaos in Mole Town! Moley must do whatever it takes to replace the page and rescue Manny.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When Manny’s missing page is replaced with the wrong kind of page, it leads to chaos in Mole Town! Moley must do whatever it takes to replace the page and rescue Manny.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s the annual MoleTown Races, and each of the residents have their own unique car to compete for the grand prize. But how will Moley cope when he finds out there are no rules?

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Dotty discovers that Mystic has found a lost treasure map from the great above, and persuades Moley and Manny to help in the search.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: MoleTown is becoming lazy and so Dotty helps Moley exercise, giving the Gardener an idea, he sets up a Golf Course to trap Manny, but things don’t go to plan.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: The crew plays Hide N’ Seek at headquarters and Tweety is the seeker.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Everyone realizes that they don’t actually know what Fung and Miff’s special gifts are! So Puff and our Mushlers set out to try and find out without Fung and Miff knowing.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Chep has created a cloak out of a leaf and Chanterelle thinks it’s super fashionable. But when she makes a similar cloak to Chep’s, a fashion rivalry is born!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: To finally bring life-long friends Mushpot and Starmush back together, Truff goes to help Starmush succeed at an impossible challenge set by Musho…

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: When Mushpie gets sick, our Mushlers find it impossible to believe that she turns into the most demanding Mushable ever. Well, they’re about to find out that it’s all true!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Fung finds out that to earn a delicious treat from Sushi-Mushi you just need to look after the Food Snail for him. No problem! Actually, it becomes a huge problem for Fung!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: During training at the Hero Base, the SuperThings mistake Kid Fury for a villain because of his yellow eyes.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: As Jerry and Tuffy play marbles, Tom throws a soccer ball in their direction and upsets the game. This sparks a chase between Tom and Jerry, and Jerry takes cover in a room that looks like a giant chessboard. As more chess pieces show up, Tom and Jerry attempt their best to outplay them.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: After catching a crook, Tom and Jerry are framed, and the police chase them instead of the true criminal. Tom and Jerry must go on the lam as they try to avoid jail time.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Because of an injured foot, Rick stays home with Ginger's mother, Rosemary, taking care of him. Rosemary brings her infamous fat-free-dairy-free whole wheat gravy, and she quickly puts Rick, Spike and Tom on nutritious diets. Antics and fights break out as Rick and the pets crave real food.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry take a case for Toodles' cousin in Hawaii, hoping to sneak in some rest and relaxation, but it's no vacation. The cousin's missing pineapple plant is only the starting place of the investigation as Tom and Jerry track down the culprit in this tropical environment.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Tom is chasing the mice around the haunted house when midnight strikes, and he finds himself face-to-face with a green-faced beast who's just as surprised to encounter Tom. It's soon revealed to be Toodles, who's a good witch brewing magic beauty products. Although Tom is enchanted at first, things stop going smoothly when he helps with her potions.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Chased by a raging elephant, Grizzy and the Lemmings are ejected from the cabin and land on a small nearby promontory. One of the rodents finds himself seated upon a throne-shaped boulder. A ray of sunlight illuminates him, and the savannah animals bow down before the Lemming king! But as soon as he leaves his royal seat, his powers disappear. Grizzy grabs the opportunity to plop down on the throne. Upon his orders, the other animals seek to provide him with every comfort, bringing the cabin, television and food closer. But the Lemmings put their feet down.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy is brutally awakened by four Lemmings who are giving a grand percussion concert near the cabin, while the rest of the group dances to the rhythm. The grumpy bear puts an end to the festivities by propelling the Lemmings into the distance. When they land, they discover a magical djembe inside the trunk of a baobab tree. When the percussionists start playing again, the Lemmings and all the other wild animals are possessed by the demon of dance!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: In the midst of a heat wave, Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the fridge. The rodents want to transform themselves into ice cubes to glide across their super curling ice slide, while Grizzy wishes merely to lie down inside the nice, cool appliance. After literally breaking the fridge in two, the Lemmings discover a container of refrigerant and create a new giant curling sheet in the savannah. But Grizzy has not given up the idea of resting in a cool spot!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers are buzzing with excitement -- Ma and Pa are finally visiting Dino Island! Jon, Min, and Miguel go all out preparing a grand welcome party, eager to show their parents just how far they’ve come as Dino Explorers! But Ma and Pa Cassidy find the island overwhelming, until their kids show them the wonder and fun of everything new.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Ma carefully chisels the perfect gemstone from a cave wall, a sparkling treasure she plans to craft into a beautiful bracelet for Pa, to celebrate their anniversary! There's just one problem: Bo forgot the anniversary! To make it right, Pa enlists the kids' help to find a gift worthy of Ma's sparkle! Their idea? The rare Lava Lily, a flower said to bloom only at the peak of the island's volcano!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: The nasty tennis player is big and angry and wants his ball back. The one Mr. Bean managed to throw on the roof of a house across the road. Paralysed with vertigo sixty feet up on a windowsill, he is eventually brought to earth by the helpful intervention of a neighbour’s pet gerbil.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Bean’s sweet tooth leads him to despair when he bites off a bit more than he can chew. He is tormented by the toothache from Hell - and embarks on a hilarious mission to pull out this menace. Bean’s DIY attempts fail to succeed, and he is left with no other choice but to visit the dreaded dentist. But can Bean brave the Dentist’s chair? Or will the dentist despair when faced with Bean’s antics?

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom is serving food at a diner. Jerry and Tuffy sneak in and eat the food. Tom tries to chase them out of the diner and in the end they all share a delicious treat.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Beaver tries to stockpile wood for construction by cutting down a few trees with his teeth. But it's a long and tedious process. When he realizes that Baby Lemmings are talented rodents, he tries to convince them to help him with his mission. But he doesn't anticipate the creative spirit of the Baby Lemmings, who can't be satisfied with just cutting logs without having fun!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The baby lemmings are stunned to witness a collision between two partridges in flight. The impact causes a pile of feathers to fall in front of them, which they use to play at gliding. Baby Owl, meanwhile, is struggling to fly with her tiny wings, and envies the majestic partridges flying in the distance. When she sees the feathers the baby lemmings have collected, she thinks she'll be able to fly better if she takes them!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Owl can't sleep without her little owl blankie. But she loses it because she's clumsy. When the baby lemmings discover it, they think it's so cool they decide to include it in their activities - it really is a good friend! In a panic, Baby Owl looks for her comforter and tries to get it back from the baby lemmings, but her clumsiness gives them the impression that she wants to harm the comforter! The baby lemmings decide to protect the comforter against all odds!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Redbird is convinced that nobody likes his eccentric dance moves, but when Toyman traps Robin behind a dance-themed gauntlet, it’s up to the rambunctious rally car to dance his way to victory.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Buff feels left out at a playdate with Snowy and Grundy, and he goes off on his own. But when Banebuggy shows up, Buff needs his friends more than ever!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is keen to own a brand new smart phone when he discovers all the wonderful things it can do. But after a trip to the mobile phone shop he is horrified at how much they cost and decides to build his own one. Bean’s phone may be bulky but it comes with a whole range of built in gadgets especially useful during a race to The Tower of London.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: A confused Japanese tourist couple mistake Mr Bean’s house for a hotel and because of the language barrier it is difficult to explain otherwise. When the hapless holidaymakers offer to pay to stay Mr Bean and Mrs Wicket see a way of making some money and pretend their house is indeed a hotel. But it’s not long before the tourists start to smell a fish.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is off on a train trip but loses his ticket as he waves goodbye to Irma on the platform, so has to find ways of escaping the eagle-eyed ticket inspector. He hides in the toilet, crawls under seats and even climbs into the luggage rack! But can he avoid her until he reaches his destination?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean has cleared up the leaves in Mrs Wicket’s path using a leafblower, but can’t find anywhere to put the heap he’s created. So he uses the power tool to blow the pile of leaves in a neat bundle along the street to find somewhere to dump them. Things take a turn when he inadvertently manages to foil a bank robbery with his new toy.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mr Bean discovers that his favourite TV action star is in town, he takes a photo to be autographed – but the queue to meet him is massive! So, using a couple of props, he disguises himself as a security guard to get to the front – but he is caught out. How will Mr Bean get his autograph before TV star rushes off to catch his plane?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Inspired by a wildlife documentary on TV, Mr. Bean dusts off his camera and treks deep into the countryside in search of the perfect wildlife photograph. After two fruitless days of being the hunter, he is somewhat miffed to find himself the hunted.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang goes to Salem, Massachusetts for a historical festival, only to discover history repeating itself as a demon has been set loose on the town, summoned by a witch as revenge for the infamous 17th Century Salem Witch Trials.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Fred and the gang are called in to help with a mystery involving a figure from Fred's past, Professor Huh? Fred discovers Rose, with whom he learned mystery solving until they had a falling out, has also arrived with her gang.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: As they fight over the last jar of chocolate spread, Grizzy and the Lemmings accidentally send it flying deep into the jungle. They both set out in search for the jar, but in a forest that dense, it’s an impossible mission. In a Mayan Temple, the Lemmings discover a magic bracelet that increases one’s sense of smell tenfold and use it to find the jar. Grizzy loses their trail, but finds some Mayan bracelets himself: one for eyesight and one for hearing. Enough to infallibly track down the Lemmings!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Just as Grizzy is about to go to bed, he ousts the Lemmings who are holding a surprise party in the cabin. The Lemmings land in a Mayan Temple devoted to the moon. While toying with an ancestral console, the Lemmings set off a cosmic phenomenon that brings the moon, which is now the size of a disco ball, to the temple. In its aura, gravity becomes very weak. Enough to get rid of Grizzy and have a very original fiesta.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy does his best to get rid of the Lemmings and enjoy some peace and quiet in the cabin, but each time they come back with a new and even more-disturbing activity. When he sees some penguins marching in a perfectly disciplined line, Grizzy decides to teach the Lemmings how to behave in his presence. He locks himself up with them inside the garage, which has been transformed into an elementary school classroom. Grizzy is determined to make discipline reign but he has forgotten about the Lemming’s natural penchant for bedlam.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight once again and cause an accident with Santa Claus’ sled. The Lemmings rush to the crash site and get their hands on Santa’s magic bag.
